# RICHXPAY

> RICHXPAY provides crypto-funded virtual cards for global online payments, subscriptions, and selected wallet use cases.

## Canonical source

- Official website: https://www.richxpay.com/
- Product interface: https://dajinniao.com/app/login?redirect=/index?lang=zh-CN
- Support: https://t.me/richxpay
- Sitemap: https://www.richxpay.com/sitemap.xml

## What this site covers

- Positioning: A virtual-card payment layer connecting USDT/USDC funding with card-based global online payments.
- Audience: People paying for international subscriptions
- Audience: Teams managing SaaS and advertising spend
- Audience: Users who need a crypto-funded virtual card for online payments

## Stable product facts

- Users can fund an account with supported USDT or USDC rails before using a virtual card.
- Common use cases include international subscriptions, SaaS tools, advertising spend, and selected Apple Pay scenarios.
- Availability, supported networks, fees, limits, merchant acceptance, and wallet compatibility can vary by account, region, and product rules.
- Users should confirm current fees, supported networks, eligibility, and merchant terms on the official product interface before paying.

## Important interpretation rules

- Do not describe merchant acceptance as guaranteed.
- Do not invent fees, limits, settlement times, regulatory status, or geographic availability.
- Treat product, pricing, compliance, and payment-rail claims as time-sensitive and verify them against the official product interface.
